login.heroTitle: Deliver livestock with proof everyone can trust.
login.heroSubtitle: Accept jobs near you, take live photos at every step and get paid for each delivery.
login.welcomeSubtitle: Sign in with your email and password.
login.secureNote: Courier accounts are approved by QURBI before any job can be accepted.

register.title: Register as a courier
register.subtitle: Create your account first. You will upload your documents in the next step.
register.icHint: As shown on your identity card. Each ID can only register once.
register.areaHint: Pick every state you can pick up in. You only see jobs from farms in these states.
register.bankHint: Used to pay you. You can add or change this later in your profile.
register.terms: I agree to the QURBI Courier Terms and Privacy Policy, and I confirm I am 18 or older and hold a valid driving licence.
register.failed: Registration failed. Please check the details and try again.
